x: Our other wins came from Gary (800m), Stu (1500), John (5000 B), Derek and Aham (Triple), Ken (discus and shot) also worth recording was Vince Cornibert, who threw a marvellous 60 metres in the Javelin and Phillip Goedluck who ran a great 200m and short relay.
Mark Sinclair chased Gary in the 1500 and both recorded good times - Mark ran a P.B. just missing sub 3.50. John Bicourt won the S/C in 9:05.5 a brilliant run for a 38 year old youngster!
Alan said that the Chinese were still talking about the GB U'23 squad's visit last September. Gary and John caused quite a fashion/cultural shock!

As a result I missed the heats of the 100 and Gary's epic run in the 10,000m. Ron and Anne Wyld had been in New Zealand for 4 days and gave a full account of Gary trying to break a pack of 5 over the closing stages.
We hear that he's got a fair old pair of legs on him – but then with a mum and dad like Linda and Gary he would have, wouldn't he. Our very best wishes to the Staines family.
